crossRefs.note: First, the standard of the camp of the children of Judah went forward according to their armies. Nahshon the son of…

translations.web: All who were counted of the camp of Judah were one hundred eighty-six thousand four hundred, according to their divisions. They shall set out first.
translations.bsb: The total number of men in the divisions of the camp of Judah is 186,400; they shall set out first.
translations.kjv: All that were numbered in the camp of Judah were an hundred thousand and fourscore thousand and six thousand and four hundred, throughout their armies. These shall first set forth.
translations.asv: All that were numbered of the camp of Judah were a hundred thousand and fourscore thousand and six thousand and four hundred, according to their hosts. They shall set forth first.
